resources.string: Enter a valid ISO date from 1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31.
Its label and duration will be discarded. Recalculate the changed schedule afterward. This cannot be undone.
Use 1–20 phases with nonblank single-line labels up to 60 UTF-16 code units and whole durations of 1–3,650 days each. Combined duration must not exceed 36,500 days.
The earliest start would fall before 1900-01-01. Shorten the plan or move the deadline.

Phases run sequentially in the displayed order, with no gaps or overlap. Each range includes both its start and finish date: a one-day phase starts and finishes on the same date. The last phase finishes on the final deadline; each earlier phase finishes one day before the next starts.

Uses calendar days, including weekends and holidays, with no time of day or time-zone calculation. This is not a parallel-task dependency planner or an official workday calendar. It creates no reminders, notifications, calendar events or commitments.
Remaining days are signed date differences from your explicit assessment date, not an estimate of work left. That date is saved with the plan and is not silently changed to today when restoring.
Labels may be private. Automatic history and remembered results are off by default. Saving manually or enabling them stores content locally. Sharing sends the reviewed plan to your chosen app.
Explicit imports restore inputs only; press Plan backward. Remember results, if enabled, can reconstruct the completed schedule using its saved assessment date.
